top.title: About Us
top.heading: Hello, I'm Suzuki!
top.intro: I'm the owner of Brush Up Stores. I'm a barber with decades of experience in both Australia and Japan. Thanks for visiting my website. I hope you'll drop by in person someday!

diy.heading: The Beginning
diy.heading-detail: Brush Up Stores started as a large DIY project.
diy.start: This is where Brush Up Stores began. When I first purchased the property, both the interior and exterior were in a state that required extensive renovation. From there, I started renovating it myself!

before-after.center-b: I started by removing parts of the interior, including the walls and floors.
before-after.center-a: Now it's a relaxing space where you can sit back and enjoy your haircut!
before-after.waiting-b: I wanted to create a space where customers visiting with children could feel comfortable too.
before-after.waiting-a: Here is the waiting area! There's also a space where children can play while they wait.
before-after.hallway-b: The hallway also needed some work on its flooring and overall appearance.
before-after.hallway-a: Now it has a simple, clean look.

diy.front: This is the entrance. I designed it so you can see the whole shop as soon as you walk in. You can also pay easily at the self-checkout.

now.detail: It took a lot of time and work, but I am now very proud to call this place my first barbershop!
now.link: I hope to see you at the shop someday!
